ValidationRule.description: If Opp record type is Higher Ed and Account revenue region is AUS then must identify ownership type at 30%.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name = 'Education', Probability >=0.30, Account.Revenue_Region__c = 'AUS', ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Sub_Industry__c, 'Higher Ed'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.Ownership_Type__c)) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ** Go to Account Record and select the Ownership Type. **
